expected_findings.root_cause: Session.get accepts the new explicit params argument but the forwarding call self.request("GET", url, **kwargs) omits it, so the value is never passed on.
expected_findings.failure_path: session.get(url, {"q": "x"}) or session.get(url, params={"q": "x"}) sends a GET with no query string; the server receives the bare URL and the caller gets a response for the wrong resource with no error.
